title: Title Services Schedule — Interstate Surcharge on Exchange Replacement Shipping for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Surcharge.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, a replacement vehicle registered through an out-of-state title service carries an interstate surcharge on the exchange replacement shipping fee. The service is the service type of the replacement order's Title & Registration Services order.

| Title & Registration Services order on the replacement | Interstate surcharge |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | $120.00 (the inspection surcharge) |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | $60.00 (the out-of-state surcharge) |
| Kestrel Title-Only Service, Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer, Kestrel In-State New Registration or Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | none |

**Where the surcharge applies.** The surcharge is added to the exchange replacement shipping fee after the transport price has been reduced by the discount and rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Discounted fee $1099.00, replacement title service Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection: $1219.00.
- Discounted fee $599.25, Kestrel Out-of-State Registration: $659.25.
- Discounted fee $799.00, Kestrel In-State New Registration: $799.00.
